versions.content: The API Dem_SelectFreezeFrameData triggers the Dem in- ternal Freeze Frame selection process on the event memory assigned to the ClientId. The Dem shall provide the result of the selection process in the return value of the API calls following the Dem_SelectFreezeFrameData call, see [SWS_Dem_01268].
